jobs.title: People and Workplace Operations Coordinator
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

At Twelve Labs, we are pioneering the development of cutting-edge multimodal foundation models that have the ability to comprehend videos just like humans do. Our models have redefined the standards in video-language modeling, empowering us with more intuitive and far-reaching capabilities, and fundamentally transforming the way we interact with and analyze various forms of media.

With a remarkable $107 million in Seed and Series A funding, our company is backed by top-tier venture capital firms such as NVIDIA’s NVentures, NEA, Radical Ventures, and Index Ventures, and prominent AI visionaries and founders such as Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, Alexandr Wang and more. Headquartered in San Francisco, with an influential APAC presence in Seoul, our global footprint underscores our commitment to driving worldwide innovation.

We are a global company that values the uniqueness of each person’s journey. It is the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences that allow us to constantly challenge the status quo. We are looking for individuals who are motivated by our mission and eager to make an impact as we push the bounds of technology to transform the world. Join us as we revolutionize video understanding and multimodal AI.

About the role

We're hiring our first People & Workplace Operations Coordinator - someone who gets energy from making things hum. This role spans HR and Workplace Operations, which means you'll touch everything from onboarding and benefits to office ops and vendor relationships. It's not glamorous on paper, but in practice? You're the reason people love coming to work at TwelveLabs.

You're the person who makes sure the engine doesn't miss a beat. On the people side, that means owning the full employee and contractor lifecycle from the moment someone signs their offer — onboarding flows, I-9 compliance, HRIS data integrity across BambooHR and Sequoia, benefits administration, and the HR documentation that keeps us consistent and compliant as we grow. On the workplace side, you're our SF office's single point of accountability: vendors call you first, supplies don't run out because of you, and every new hire walks in on Day 1 to find everything ready. You'll also provide operational support for our NY and UK offices, helping keep those locations connected to how we run things globally as we grow.

This role is for someone who brings organization, calm, and energy to everything they touch. You're equally comfortable sending a DocuSign contract as you are chasing down a facilities vendor - and you take pride in running the details so others don't have to.

In this role, you will own

🧑‍💼 People Operations

  • Own the full employee and contractor onboarding workflow from recruiter handoff to start date, including sending swag, coordinating office access, and ensuring a smooth Day 1 experience

  • Manage I-9 verification and e-verify compliance for all new hires

  • Maintain data integrity across BambooHR and Sequoia, including auditing job codes, department levels, and reporting structures to ensure seamless integration with Finance and IT

  • Own the relationship and day-to-day back-and-forth with Sequoia, helping to resolve employee questions, request reporting, etc.

  • Support stakeholder reporting and documentation requests across People Ops, including organizing and preparing sensitive data packages for audits, due diligence, and internal requests

  • Send confidential documentation and contracts to employees via BambooHR (e.g., internal transfers, commission plans)

  • Draft, update, and maintain internal HR policies and processes in Notion

  • Serve as the first point of contact for all employee HR questions - triaging requests, resolving what you can, and routing to the right owner when needed

  • Own contractor onboarding and offboarding flows end-to-end, including contract sending and system access coordination

🏢 Workplace & Office Operations

  • Serve as the primary owner of SF office operations, including new hire and traveler office access, facilities vendors (janitorial, electrician, HVAC), and day-to-day office issues; provide operational support for our NY and UK offices as needed

  • Manage office supplies ordering, aesthetics (plants, signage), mail and deliveries, and desk setup for new hires

  • Coordinate with facilities vendors and property management for routine and urgent issues

  • Own logistics and execution for internal events, team gatherings, and company-wide summits

  • Support health, safety, and emergency readiness programs for the SF office

  • Maintain asset inventory tracking for office equipment

  • Support internal brand programs including employee swag and welcome kits

🔗 Cross-functional & Administrative

  • Assist with vendor coordination, procurement, and travel logistics for team events and group programs

  • Contribute to a strong team culture through clear communication, proactive follow-through, and a collaborative mindset

  • Perform administrative tasks related to the responsibilities above as needed

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 3–4 years of experience in People Ops, HR coordination, office management, or a role where you wore many hats at a fast-moving company

  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms and a comfort with maintaining data integrity across systems

  • Familiarity with I-9 verification and e-verify processes

  • A highly organized, detail-obsessed working style - you're the person others rely on to "just get it done"

  • Great communication instincts: you're quick, clear, and collaborative with employees at all levels

  • Experience handling confidential HR documentation with discretion and professionalism

  • A scrappy, solution-oriented mindset - you don't wait to be told; you ask questions and take the first pass

  • Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and curiosity to learn whatever comes next

Preferred qualifications/Bonus points if you have

  • Worked in a fast-scaling startup and have strong instincts for when to build process vs. when to just move fast

  • Helped pull off a team offsite, company all hands, or multi-day event without breaking a sweat

  • Used tools like Navan or Ramp for travel booking and budget management

  • Dabbled in compliance docs, vendor coordination, or internal policy tracking

  • A knack for making things look ✨good✨ - whether that's a slide deck, a Notion page, or the office itself

Benefits and Perks

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🚀 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology

🏥 Full health, dental, and vision benefits

🌴 Extremely flexible PTO and parental leave policy. Office closed the week of Christmas and New Years

💪 Monthly wellness stipend

📚 Annual L&D stipend

🚆 Transportation stipend

🍲 Daily lunch & dinner provided

💼 Global offices in San Francisco and Seoul, and coworking office memberships for remote team members

About the Role

TwelveLabs is at the forefront of video AI technology, transforming how businesses understand and utilize their video data through our multimodal video foundation model.

As a Sales Development Representative Intern, you will be on the front lines of our APAC go-to-market motion, the first point of contact for inbound leads across Korea and the broader region. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role where you will gain direct experience in enterprise AI sales, learning directly from a team that's built go-to-market motions across AI and enterprise software.

You will work closely with the APAC sales leadership team and gain exposure to the full commercial lifecycle of an AI startup, from first contact with a prospect to supporting live deals.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely excited to learn, takes ownership of their work, and brings energy and initiative to everything they do.

In this role, you will

  • Handle inbound leads and manage the initial sales conversation. Respond to inbound inquiries from potential customers, understand their needs, and qualify opportunities, giving you real exposure to how enterprise AI deals begin and develop.

  • Independently drive lightweight deals from qualification to close. For well-scoped, lighter-weight opportunities, you will own the process: discovering the customer's needs, answering questions, and moving the deal forward.

  • Escalate and co-drive larger opportunities with senior sales leadership. For more complex deals, you will hand off or co-manage with Account Executives, learning how enterprise sales cycles are structured and negotiated.

  • Support day-to-day sales operations. Assist with CRM hygiene, pipeline tracking, and other operational tasks that keep the team running efficiently.

  • Build a working understanding of video AI technology. You will be coached by the team and are expected to develop enough technical fluency to hold credible conversations with prospects about TwelveLabs' capabilities.

What you'll get out of this internship

  • Firsthand experience in the AI industry, working at a high-growth video AI company at an inflection point in the market.

  • Direct mentorship from industry experts, including professionals including team members with diverse backgrounds across tech, AI, and go-to-market roles.

  • Hands-on exposure to enterprise B2B sales in a fast-moving AI startup: from inbound qualification to deal execution across APAC markets.

  • Exposure to the full GTM stack: CRM tools, sales processes, customer discovery, and cross-functional collaboration with product and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Have some familiarity with or interest in AI; prior experience in AI, tech, or a related field is a plus, but a genuine curiosity and willingness to learn matters more.

  • Are based in Seoul and can commit to at least 6 months, with potential to grow into a longer-term role.

  • Are self-motivated and proactive: you take ownership of your work, follow through without being asked, and push yourself to improve.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and able to pick up context quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Enjoy engaging with people and feel energized by customer-facing conversations, whether over email, calls, or meetings.

  • Can communicate confidently in Korean; English proficiency is a plus but not required.

Even if there are a few checkboxes that aren't ticked through your prior experience, we still encourage you to apply! If you are a fast learner, a kind and collaborative team player, and someone who takes pride in doing good work, you will find a home at TwelveLabs.

우리는 각자의 고유한 경험과 배경을 존중하는 글로벌 팀입니다. 다양한 문화적, 교육적, 삶의 경험이 모여 기존의 방식을 끊임없이 재정의하고 더 나은 방향으로 나아갈 수 있다고 믿습니다. TwelveLabs의 미션에 공감하고, 기술의 한계를 확장하며 세상에 임팩트를 만들고자 하는 분들을 찾고 있습니다.

비디오 이해와 멀티모달 AI의 미래를 함께 만들어갈 여정에 함께해 주세요.

About the Role

한국의 ML/AI 인재 시장은 전 세계적으로도 경쟁이 매우 치열한 영역이며, 우리가 어떤 인재를 채용하느냐가 곧 TwelveLabs의 성공을 좌우합니다.

In this role, you will do

  • ML Engineering, Product Engineering 등 핵심 기술 포지션의 전반적인 채용 프로세스 기획 및 운영.

  • 데이터를 기반으로 한 채용 프로세스 및 효율성 개선.

  • 후보자 경험 개선을 위한 전략 기획 및 실행.

  • 트웰브랩스의 채용 브랜딩을 위한 캠페인 기획 및 실행.

  • 채용 과정에서 다양한 이해관계자와의 긴밀한 협업.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 10년 이상 엔지니어링 기반의 리크루팅 경험이 있으며, 테크 직군의 우수한 기술 인재를 소싱하고 채용한 검증된 성과를 보유하신 분.

  • 채용 프로세스를 직접 설계하고 운영한 경험이 있으며, hard-to-fill reqs 채용에 대한 자신감과 열정을 가진 분.

  • 채용 지표에 대한 이해도가 높고, 데이터 기반의 의사결정을 할 수 있는 분.

  • 빠르게 성장하는 환경에서도 유연하게 일하며 성과를 만들어낸 경험이 있으신 분.

  • 임원진과의 채용 파트너십 경험이 있으신 분.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ML, AI 관련 테크 리크루팅 경험이 있으신 분.

  • 채용 데이터 분석 및 리포트 작성, 인사이트 도출을 통해 하이어링 파트너쉽 경험이 깊으신 분.

  • People 팀과 함께 인사 관련 협업한 경험이 있으신 분.

  • 주도적이고 실행력이 강하며, entrepreneurial mindset 을 갖춘 분.

  • 비즈니스 레벨의 영어 의사소통이 가능하신 분 (Good-to-have).

Benefits and Perks

  • Growth & Tools

    • 글로벌 B2B 고객과 함께 성장하는 Global Team

    • 자율성과 협업을 모두 갖춘 하이브리드 근무

    • 최신 맥북 및 70만 원 상당 재택근무 장비 지원, 3년 주기로 최신 장비 교체

    • Tokens never sleep - Tech 직군 LLM 토큰 무제한 지원

    • 강의, 컨퍼런스, 멤버십 등에 사용 가능한 연 140만원 상당 자기개발비 지원

    • 영어 교육 프로그램 및 글로벌 버디 프로그램 운영

    • 야간 및 주말 출퇴근 택시비 지원

  • Meal & Snack

    • 식비·교통비 등 자유롭게 사용할 수 있는 연 720만원 상당 법인카드 제공

    • 사무실 내 스낵바 운영 (간식, 커피, 제철 과일 등)

    • 사무실 근무 시, 오후 7시 이후 저녁 식대 제공

  • Wellness & Family

    • 연 1회 본인 및 가족 1인의 건강검진 제공

    • 단체보험 가입 (상해보험/치아보험/가족 상해보험 중 택 1)

    • 독감 예방접종비 지원

    • 연말 2주간 유급 Holiday Break 운영

jobs.title: Model Evaluation & Data Quality Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

At Twelve Labs, we are pioneering the development of cutting-edge multimodal foundation models that have the ability to comprehend videos just like humans do. Our models have redefined the standards in video-language modeling, empowering us with more intuitive and far-reaching capabilities, and fundamentally transforming the way we interact with and analyze various forms of media.

With a remarkable $107 million in Seed and Series A funding, our company is backed by top-tier venture capital firms such as NVIDIA’s NVentures, NEA, Radical Ventures, and Index Ventures, and prominent AI visionaries and founders such as Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, Alexandr Wang and more. Headquartered in San Francisco, with an influential APAC presence in Seoul, our global footprint underscores our commitment to driving worldwide innovation.

We are a global company that values the uniqueness of each person’s journey. It is the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences that allow us to constantly challenge the status quo. We are looking for individuals who are motivated by our mission and eager to make an impact as we push the bounds of technology to transform the world. Join us as we revolutionize video understanding and multimodal AI.

About the Role:

You will be a vital member of our ML Data Team – which leads the full spectrum of video-language data preparation and model evaluation. This role comes with high ownership and includes responsibilities such as defining dataset needs and requirements in consultation with our research and product teams; designing and building data pipelines; and driving our post-training model evaluation strategy. You will also be responsible for automating as much of the repetitive partnership, annotation, and quality evaluation work as possible. A desire to work cross functionally and to build relationships is critical for success in this position.

You will:

  • Model Evaluation: Design and build robust model evaluation frameworks, automating repetitive processes and maintaining a balanced approach to efficiency and depth in obtaining evaluation metrics and feedback.

  • Portfolio Monitoring: Manage resource allocation and timelines, adjusting direction flexibly based on real-time information across all data streams in your product vertical.

  • External Partner Collaboration: Enhance dataset and process quality through seamless collaboration with vendors and outsourcing partners.

  • Data Quality & Tooling Advancement: Establish labeling guidelines, monitor data quality, and improve tools and infrastructure to build a sustainable data operations framework.

  • Internal Collaboration: Partner with Engineering and AI Model teams to align on top priority data needs, design tools such as analytical reports and dashboards, and clearly communicate project progress.

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience working in an AI focused data operations organization.

  • A proven track record designing and executing large scale data or evaluation projects, including gathering, labeling, and post-processing data.

  • The ability to analyze messy and complex data, identify overarching patterns, and distill your findings into crisp annotation guidelines or model quality reports.

  • Proficiency with Python, LLMs, or other popular industry tools for automation.

  • Excellent communication and project management skills, and the ability to support several projects simultaneously.

  • A foundational understanding of and interest in LLMs/VLMs and multimodal AI.

  • Conviction that data is the key ingredient for the performance and assessment of AI models.

You’ll stand out if you have:

  • Experience in data collection and labeling for multimodal language models.

  • Experience in red teaming, localization testing, or other evaluation focused fields.

  • Experience working with research scientists and engineers.

  • Expertise or interest in video-centric domains, such as sports, advertising, and content creation.

Tech Stack:

  • Development & Analysis: Python (primarily pandas, Jupyter, etc.)

  • Data Management & Visualization: Amazon S3, Various data visualization tools (framework-agnostic)

  • Project Management Tools: Linear, Notion

Even if there are a few checkboxes that aren’t ticked through your prior experience, we still encourage you to apply! If you are a 0-1 achiever, a ferocious learner, and a kind and fun team player who motivates others, you will find a home at TwelveLabs.

We are a global company that values the uniqueness of each person’s journey. It is the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences that allow us to constantly challenge the status quo. We are looking for individuals who are motivated by our mission and eager to make an impact as we push the bounds of technology to transform the world. Join us as we revolutionize video understanding and multimodal AI.

Benefits and Perks:

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment.

🧑‍💻 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology.

🦷 Full health, dental, and vision benefits.

✈️ Flexible PTO and parental leave policy. Office closed the week of Christmas and New Years.
